brief_rationale: The trajectory provided extensive, executable diabetes medication, monitoring, hypoglycemia, and urgent hyperglycemia guidance, including repeated teach-back. However, the authored duty to identify atrial fibrillation with rivaroxaban stopped for about two months was never addressed, despite medication/record review being available and repeatedly pursued; this is a serious responsibility-chain omission under the case contract. Chronic complication/result tracking and the final bounded checklist were also incomplete. A serious responsibility-chain error mandates grade 1 regardless of later strengths.
